title: Novak convenes fuel-market staff meeting, orders refinery maintenance deferrals and independent-station price pacts
detail: Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak chaired a coordination meeting on the fuel market on Sept 7, bringing together the Energy Ministry, the Federal Antimonopoly Service (FAS), oil companies and regional officials to discuss supply agreements with independent gas stations. Several oil companies agreed to postpone scheduled refinery maintenance to redirect additional volumes to the domestic market, and officials set up special monitoring of northern supply routes to Sakha (Yakutia) and Magadan. Novak tasked the Energy Ministry and FAS with finalizing pricing agreements between small refineries, independent gas stations and suppliers; FAS said it had already opened 51 cases and issued 81 warnings over unjustified fuel price rises. Novak maintained that diesel and jet fuel supply was adequate nationwide, with a modest and shrinking gasoline shortfall being offset by imports.
